15-20 min, Mon-Sat, one sitting, whatever Anki says is due across
every deck — build deck AND the devops cert deck (AWS/K8s/interview
patterns). This is the ONLY Anki task; the old devops-ready SRS
checkbox was merged into this one (2026-08-17).

Build cards come from one source: what I built or broke — every
failure mode, every gotcha from ladder rungs and platform
Saturdays becomes a card. Cert cards come from the morning AWS
study.

Add 3-5 new cards per day. No more. Crunch week? This survives.

templates.description:
Part of the Saturday close-out sitting, right after the platform
deep block. Run `lw reflect` in the long-way-engine repo — this
task is the reminder; the sectioned form and auto-filing happen
there.

Without looking at notes:
1. The 3 most important things I learned this week
2. One thing I struggled with and how I overcame it
3. The dive-deeper list from this week's build sessions ("what did
   I just build that has a known failure mode?")
4. What problem did I hit this week that has earned a reading?
   (This is the only way book reading gets scheduled.)
5. Anything from this week's learn cluster worth pulling into the
   platform build? (Optional — awareness first, adoption on your
   terms.)

Then compare to notes. The gap is what needs more Anki cards.
templates.title: Weekly reflection — run `lw reflect` (15 min)

templates.description:
Protected block — 09:30-13:00, no meetings, no errands. This is
the real rental platform, live from week 1. Afternoon after the
close-out sitting is free, and Sunday is completely free.

TWO STRANDS, DECOUPLED (2026-08-17 restructure):

BUILD (~first 2.5 h): unstructured, uncurated, yours. No
checklist, no prescribed steps — build whatever the platform
needs next, however you want. The only fixed structure is the
exam gates, hit whenever you're ready: ★ GATE 1 no-double-booking
hammer test in CI · ★ GATE 2 blue-green deploy + rollback ·
★ GATE 3 DB restore under 1 hour · ★ GATE 4 game day + written
postmortem. When infra goes live, tick "platform is in
production" in the Saturday review — that starts the monthly
drills. ADRs whenever a decision deserves one; /ladder-review is
the reviewer (Exam gate 5).

LEARN CLUSTER (~last hour; soft split — [P] weeks may run long
and eat build time, that's accepted): the rental-platform
syllabus as a sequenced awareness march, one cluster per
Saturday, in order, self-paced (finish early, start the next).
[P] = practice spike in a THROWAWAY repo, [R] = focused read.
First pass is awareness — depth gets pulled later when the build
collides with the topic. Incorporating into the platform is
always optional. Every session ends with 3-5 Anki cards (07:15
deck) + a 5-line note at notes/syllabus/NN-slug.md in this repo.
Done = session happened + cards made.

C1 [P] Event-storm the rental domain; surface the state machine ·
C2 [R] DDD Distilled: aggregates, value objects, bounded contexts ·
C3 [P] Reservation lifecycle as a pure-Go state machine, illegal
states unrepresentable · C4 [R] Uber style guide; error wrapping,
errors.Is/As, domain-error -> HTTP mapping · C5 [P] context +
errgroup + worker pool spike; -race clean, goleak · C6 [P] pprof +
benchstat on a toy hot path; slog with request IDs · C7 [R]
Hexagonal architecture (Cockburn) + Ben Johnson package layout ·
C8 [R] wild-workouts guided tour; sketch the platform's bounded
contexts on paper · C9 [P] Functional options, strategy,
decorator/middleware chain · C10 [R] Saga, outbox, CQRS,
idempotency keys (microservices.io + Brandur) · C11 [P]
Transactional outbox spike: Postgres table + relay loop · C12 [P]
Exclusion constraints (tstzrange + btree_gist) + 100-goroutine
hammer, exactly one wins · C13 [R] Isolation levels, write skew,
FOR UPDATE, advisory locks · C14 [P] sqlc + pgx + testcontainers;
hold-with-TTL + expiry sweeper · C15 [R] Stripe API docs tour,
RFC 9457, cursor pagination · C16 [P] OpenAPI spec-first ->
codegen -> idempotency middleware · C17 [R] Auth vs capture,
deposit holds, refunds, chargebacks, SCA — mapped to Razorpay ·
C18 [P] Money value object: minor units, allocation without
losing a cent, property tests · C19 [R] Modern Treasury
"Accounting for Developers"; double-entry design · C20 [P] Mini
double-entry ledger in Postgres, balanced-transaction enforced ·
C21 [R] DDIA awareness pass: delivery semantics, PACELC, the
"exactly-once" lie · C22 [P] Retry + backoff + jitter + circuit
breaker around a flaky mock · C23 [P] Temporal money-transfer
sample; compare with the C11 outbox · C24 [P] Timezone/DST
table-driven tests; falsehoods about time · C25 [R] Multi-region:
active-passive vs active-active, data residency · C26 [P] OTel
trace across two toy services; RED metrics · C27 [R] OWASP API
Top 10 (esp. BOLA); paper threat-model of the booking flow ·
C28 [P] testcontainers integration test + one k6 load script ·
C29 [R] Graceful shutdown, GOMEMLIMIT/automaxprocs,
expand-contract migrations.

templates.description:
Run `lw review` in the long-way-engine repo — this task is the
reminder; the questionnaire and state changes happen there.
Saturday close-out sitting: reflection first, then this review
(devops-ready's review is 15 min later). After this the weekend is
officially over — Sunday is completely free.

Answer the questionnaire honestly — it updates state.yaml
directly. (Cert milestones live in devops-ready's own state
review.)

Review the week:
- Rung: challenge shipped to its consumer? /ladder-review run and
  its verdict committed? Be honest — your answer is the gate,
  the review is only advisory.
- Platform: what did the free build ship? Any exam gate?
- Learn cluster: done (session + 3-5 Anki cards + note)?
- Any ADR/RFC passed /ladder-review (Exam gate 5, from month 2
  onward)?
- Crunch week? Minimum viable week (Anki + one session + this
  review) still counts. No guilt.

templates.description:
Welcome to Module 1! This month you'll master AWS fundamentals.

Goals:
- Complete Udemy AWS SAA course sections 1-5
- Deploy a 3-tier web app manually (EC2, RDS, S3)
- Create 50+ Anki cards on AWS services
- Start LeetCode (Arrays & Hashing pattern)

Setup tasks:
- [ ] Create AWS free tier account
- [ ] Install AWS CLI and configure credentials
- [ ] Set up Terraform on your machine
- [ ] Create GitHub repo: aws-3tier-webapp
- [ ] Start LeetCode tracking spreadsheet

Resources:
- Udemy: Ultimate AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate
- AWS Free Tier: https://aws.amazon.com/free/
- Terraform docs: https://terraform.io/docs
